Compound movements first 🏋🏼‍♀️
Big lifts first, while you’re fresh, strong & ready to work.

Progressive overload 📈
More weight, more reps or better execution over time = growth.

Full range of motion ✨
Control your reps, use a good range & make every rep count.

Don’t just move the weight — focus on feeling your glutes doing the work.

Recovery is crucial 💤🩷
Train hard, then let them GROW. Fuel your body, prioritise protein & get your rest.

Lift. Fuel. Recover. Repeat. 🎀

title: Visceral fat isn’t always the fat you can see in the mirror.
hook: Visceral fat isn’t always the fat you can see in the mirror.
caption:
Visceral fat isn’t always the fat you can see in the mirror.

It’s the fat surrounding your organs, and it can play a major role in metabolic health, insulin sensitivity, inflammation, and how your body responds to fat loss.

That’s why I’m a big believer in looking beyond just the number on the scale.

The right approach should include:
• Strength training
• Daily movement + Zone 2 cardio
• Adequate protein
• Sleep + recovery
• Metabolic support tailored to the individual
